ideal_customer: We sell route-planning and fleet-tracking software to logistics and delivery companies with 50 to 1,000 employees. Our buyers run operations, logistics or IT.

leads.name: Head of Logistics, Northline Freight (220 employees)
leads.message: Our dispatchers still plan 60 vans a day in spreadsheets. We need route optimisation live before peak season in October and have budget approved.

leads.message: Hi, I'm writing my thesis on last-mile delivery. Could I get a free account for research?
